name: Completed Downloads Remove All
changes: Adds a Remove all completed button in Downloads > Completed with total-count confirmation across every history page.
Clears finalized completed history from NewzDeck durable terminal index and the SAB history-only API without deleting downloaded/imported files.
Preserves active, queued, post-processing and failed downloads, download statistics, and application settings.
regression_guards: Preserves v3.7.13 deferred-preview timeout and image integrity fixes.
Verifies completion cleanup never calls SAB queue delete or del_files=1.
Preserves SABnzbd 5.1.2, SABCTools 9.6.3, Automation, Smart Import, and managed updates.
preserved: Newsgroup gallery/Image Sets/v3.7.13 deferred recovery, 12 themes, downloader engine and library storage unchanged.
